newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to buy 2 auto dealers.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to buy 2 auto dealers.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire Chesrown Automotive Group and Bankston Enterprises for $104 million in Republic common stock.
Republic said each transaction is being accounted for as a pooling of interests, and includes the related real estate.

Chesrown owns and operates Chevrolet, Geo, Ford, Kia, Dodge, Lincoln- Mercury, and Mazda dealerships in the Denver and Boulder, Colorado areas. Bankston owns and operates Lincoln-Mercury, Saab, Ford, and Nissan dealerships in the Dallas, Texas area.
